notes: Pooled medians use14 checked samples per product; adjacent AB and DC comparisons use seven-sample round medians.
Descriptive observations, not significance estimates; construction and checksums remain in execution time.
Wasmtime RSS is a sampled whole-invocation process value, not isolated guest peak/live heap/allocation bytes.
V8 RSS/heap are process-wide endpoints under natural GC; they are not comparable live workload counters.
GC capacity is reserved heap capacity, not live bytes, allocated bytes or collection count.
R module bytes are reported by the executing boundary; R code-body/native-text sizes are unavailable.

Measurements used a shared host with observed unrelated CPU activity and desktop work; per-round load averages are retained. This is not idle-machine repeatability, statistical or causal certification, or V8 parity certification.

notes: Separate transformed-source cohort; not interchangeable with ordinary fresh-Realm timings.
Seven callbacks per session after ten guest warmups in one initialized Realm; two fresh sessions per product in ABBA order.
Pooled14-sample medians are descriptive; both session medians, all raw callback timestamps and adjacent changes remain visible.
Spans include one batch call, workload construction/checksum and marker return/entry overhead; setup, warmups, checksum printing and native compilation are outside. No empty subtraction.
Call intervals are elapsed wall time, not isolated CPU time. Whole-child RSS and whole-program GC capacity do not establish per-call peak/live/allocation counts.
